items.title: Pay Q1 2026 childcare invoice
items.quote: The total is payable within 10 days of the invoice date.
items.computation: Invoice date is 30 December 2025. This is a private company invoice, so ordinary civil-law period counting under §§ 187, 188 BGB applies (no statutory administrative delivery fiction, as this is not a letter from an authority). The period 'within 10 days of the invoice date' begins with an event (the invoice date), so under § 187(1) BGB the day of the event (30 Dec 2025) is not counted; the period starts the next day, 31 Dec 2025 (day 1). Counting 10 days: 31 Dec (1), 1 Jan (2), 2 Jan (3), 3 Jan (4), 4 Jan (5), 5 Jan (6), 6 Jan (7), 7 Jan (8), 8 Jan (9), 9 Jan (10). Day 10 is Friday, 9 January 2026, which is a regular business day in NW (not a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday), so § 193 BGB does not shift the date further.
